answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a nadir bet on surviving 45 epochs of grading, and every terrace settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 45 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
